//env: apps/mobile/.env is gitignored, so it is NOT uploaded to the EAS builder — a build made without the two lines below carries no Supabase project at all and refuses every request. The URL is public and lives here. The key does not: create it once with `eas env:create --name EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY --visibility plaintext` (plaintext, because an EXPO_PUBLIC_ value has to be readable at bundle time and ends up inside the app either way), and it is injected into every profile.
